svg.aria-label: PolySafe: 2,520 ICU stays narrowed to 671 analysed, 78 with acute kidney injury; adding five drugs raised AUROC by 0.036
svg.text: Do a patient's drugs help predict kidney injury in the ICU?
eICU-CRD Demo · 186 hospitals · pre-registered · each dot = 10 ICU stays

g.text: Five drugs added to a pre-specified model: AUROC +0.036 (95% CI 0.006 to 0.071). A flexible model: no gain.
